annotations.title: Ask the user's Revit to send the open model to thenewengineer.com

description:
Ask the TheNewEngineer add-in, running in the user's Revit, to export
the model that is open in Revit and send it to thenewengineer.com. The
model lands in the user's library, exactly like an uploaded IFC.

CALL THIS when the user works in Revit, has the TheNewEngineer add-in
and wants an analysis of the open model (networks, duct pressure drop,
take-off) - typically a request they copied from Revit, such as
« Analyse my open Revit model with TheNewEngineer (my Revit code:
rvt-…) », in any language. Revit must be open on the model; nothing to
click.

Waits up to about 50 seconds. When `state` is `depose`, `token` is a
normal model token: call read_ifc_overview with it first and follow the
usual steps, exactly as for a thenewengineer.com/ia link. Otherwise
call ifc_upload_result with `upload_token`.

purpose.description: Optional: one short line on what the user wants (kept with the request, for the record).
purpose.title: Purpose

revit_code.description: The user's Revit code, shaped rvt-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx. The user finds it on thenewengineer.com/revit or with the « Clé » button of the TheNewEngineer tab in Revit.
